title: Pacific Crest Trail
who: Classic route · Mexico to Canada on foot
summary: About 4,265 km from the Mexican border to Canada through California, Oregon and Washington: desert, the High Sierra, volcanoes and old forest. A few thousand people start each year; most hike northbound, timing the desert before summer and the Sierra after the snow.

sources.label: Halfway Anywhere: PCT best moments, class of 2025
Halfway Anywhere: PCT tips from the class of 2025

approximate: The usual resupply towns and landmarks; the line follows trails near the PCT where they were found.

stops.name: Southern Terminus
stops.text: A wooden monument at the Mexican border. Northbound hikers start here in spring.

stops.name: Julian
stops.text: Through the Laguna Mountains to an old gold-rush town famous for its apple pie.

stops.name: Idyllwild
stops.text: A mountain village in the San Jacinto range.

stops.name: Big Bear Lake
stops.text: Down to the desert floor at the I-10 and up again into the San Bernardinos.

stops.name: Wrightwood
stops.text: Near Mount Baden-Powell in the San Gabriels.

stops.name: Tehachapi
stops.text: Across the Mojave edge along the aqueduct, among the wind turbines.

photo.credit: John Wiley User:Jw4nvc - Santa Barbara, California

stops.name: Kennedy Meadows
stops.text: The end of the desert, mile 702. Hikers pick up bear canisters and ice axes for the Sierra.

stops.name: Mount Whitney side trip
stops.text: A detour up the highest summit in the lower 48 states, 4,421 m.

stops.name: High Sierra
stops.text: Shared with the John Muir Trail: high passes, cold fords, granite and lakes, days from any road.

stops.name: Tuolumne Meadows
stops.text: Yosemite's high country.

photo.credit: Steve Dunleavy from Lake Tahoe, NV, United States

stops.name: South Lake Tahoe
stops.text: Through Desolation Wilderness and along the lake.

stops.name: Sierra City
stops.text: An old mining village under the Sierra Buttes.

stops.name: Chester
stops.text: Near the trail's halfway point, about 2,130 km from Mexico.

stops.name: Burney Falls
stops.text: Past Lassen's volcanic country to a waterfall pouring out of the rock.

stops.name: Mount Shasta
stops.text: Castle Crags and the white cone of Shasta in view for days.

stops.name: Ashland
stops.text: Into Oregon, a theatre town where hikers celebrate leaving California.

stops.name: Crater Lake
stops.text: The deepest lake in the US, inside a collapsed volcano.

stops.name: Sisters
stops.text: Lava fields and the Three Sisters volcanoes.

stops.name: Timberline Lodge
stops.text: On the slopes of Mount Hood, famous for its breakfast buffet.

stops.name: Cascade Locks
stops.text: Down the Eagle Creek area to the Columbia River, and the Bridge of the Gods into Washington.

source.label: Fastest known time through Oregon, July 2025

stops.name: Goat Rocks
stops.text: The Knife's Edge in the Goat Rocks, with Mount Rainier close.

stops.name: Snoqualmie Pass
stops.text: Into the steep, wet North Cascades.

stops.name: Stehekin
stops.text: A village reached only by boat, plane or trail, with a famous bakery.

stops.name: Northern Terminus
stops.text: The monument at the Canadian border, and on to Manning Park: about 4,265 km from Mexico.
